subject: Re: Amplitude contract renewal — retention / egress scenarios
messages:
From: Jared Collins <jared@amplitude.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming Amplitude contract renewal — retention / egress options

Hi Marissa,

Quick heads up — your Amplitude subscription (Account: Redwood Inference, Account ID 74219) is up for renewal on 2027-05-15. Based on the telemetry footprint you gave us last quarter, there are a couple of routes we can take that materially change price by retention window and egress allowances:

- Option A: 90-day event retention, standard egress (included up to 1TB/month) — roughly +8% on list price.
- Option B: 365-day event retention, egress billed separately — roughly +28% on list price.
- Option C: 90-day retention + event replay pack (for long-term BI exports) — add-on fee.

I've attached a short pricing summary and a sample SOW. If helpful, we can also provide a DocuSign link to expedite.

Before we lock anything, curious if you want us to include an enterprise data egress credit line (we can propose up to 20% credit for committed egress). Also happy to run a 12-month committed usage discount if you can commit to a minimum events/month target.

Would you and your procurement lead be available next week for a 30-minute call to run scenarios?

Best,
Jared
Account Exec, Amplitude
jared@amplitude.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming Amplitude contract renewal — retention / egress options

Team — looping procurement and product analytics owners.

Thanks Jared for the overview (cc'd here). A few immediate asks from our side as we triage:

1) Monica (procurement): can you start drafting an internal checklist for contract must-haves? I want explicit language on data egress caps, subprocessor notifications, and audit log retention.
2) Laura / Marcus: can you confirm whether Product will require 365d retention for feature analytics or whether 90d + replay pack is acceptable given our BI exports? I've attached a quick CSV of our 2026 telemetry trends for reference — helps show peak event months.
3) If we do pursue a committed egress credit, we should see both the amortized cost and operational lift (who owns exports).

Propose a short runbook: enable Jared to share exact pricing for the two scenarios (90d vs 365d) and one committed-usage discount scenario. We will then bring a legal checklist and target concessions.

Availability: Tue/Wed next week morning PST works for me.

Thanks —
Marissa
Sr. Product Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Agree with Marissa. Quick note from product: our current dashboards rely on 180+ day cohorts for a handful of metrics (user churn windows), but we can backfill via replay if retention is limited. If we can get a 30% credit tied to a 12-month committed events volume, I think that gets us close to budget.

Short ask: can procurement push for either a one-time onboarding credit or reduced egress rate for the first 6 months? That buys us runway while we finalize storage policies.

Jared — thanks. We're ready to evaluate concrete numbers. Please send:

- Line-item pricing for Scenario 1 (90-day retention, egress included up to 1TB; committed usage discount tiers: none / 12-month commit / 24-month commit).
- Line-item pricing for Scenario 2 (365-day retention, egress billed; include egress unit price and a discounted egress credit option).
- Any one-time onboarding credit offers and trial egress allowances.
- Security questionnaire link + SOC2 report (we'll share with InfoSec).

Attaching our monthly telemetry export (redwood_analysis_telemetry_usage.csv) so you can map cost by month. Also note: legal will insist on a KMS/SAML clause and a restriction on subprocessor changes without 30-day notice.

If you can return numbers and a DocuSign draft by EOD next Thursday (2027-04-15), we'll aim to get internal sign-off the following week.

Cheers,
Marissa

Subject: Amplitude renewal — internal next steps and sign-off path

Team — quick update and decisions:

- Jared sent a final offer (see his pricing PDF and DocuSign link). Scenario 1 with a 12-month commit gives us the best near-term unit economics (estimated $64.8k/yr + onboarding credit).
- Action items:
  - Monica: please run this against our SOW checklist and confirm whether the KMS/SAML language Jared mentioned is acceptable. Legal will want subprocessor notice added.
  - Laura: confirm that 90d retention + replay pack is operationally acceptable for the Q2 experiments (if not, we escalate to Scenario 2).
  - Marcus/Tessa: evaluate dashboard impacts and whether BI exports will need additional tooling if egress is capped.

Tentative path: procurement to negotiate DocuSign redlines this week; legal review early next week; target signature by 2027-04-22 to avoid auto-renewal terms. If legal flags major issues on KMS/SAML, we will pause signature and run a 2-week escalation.

Please reply with quick thumbs up / concerns. If we get consensus, Monica will instruct Jared to prepare a redlined DocuSign for signature.

Thanks —
